ceu: ✦ The opposition between the Moon and Venus at {H:1821123650000}

t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.
Until {H:1821099381000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up rest and your inner life.
The opposition between the Moon and Venus creates some tension between your image and relationships. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Take five minutes when you wake up to decide how you want to feel today.

t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.
Until {H:1821099381000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.
The opposition between the Moon and Venus creates some tension between your inner life and routine. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Say no to a commitment that wears you out.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.
Until {H:1821099381000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up your career and your goals.
The opposition between the Moon and Venus creates some tension between friendships and romance. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Listen to a friend's idea with real enthusiasm.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.
Until {H:1821099381000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.
The opposition between the Moon and Venus creates some tension between your career and family. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Set a clear goal for this week and write it down.

t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.
Until {H:1821099381000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.
The opposition between the Moon and Venus creates some tension between your horizons and conversations. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Talk with someone from another generation or another culture.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.
Until {H:1821099381000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.
The opposition between the Moon and Venus creates some tension between intimacy and money. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Throw away something you keep only out of attachment.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.
Until {H:1821099381000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.
The opposition between the Moon and Venus creates some tension between relationships and your image. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Own up to a mistake of yours in a relationship, without beating about the bush.

t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.
Until {H:1821099381000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.
The opposition between the Moon and Venus creates some tension between routine and your inner life. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Drink a glass of water as soon as you wake up.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.
Until {H:1821099381000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up home and family.
The opposition between the Moon and Venus creates some tension between romance and friendships. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Play with a child or remember what it was like to play.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.
Until {H:1821099381000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.
The opposition between the Moon and Venus creates some tension between family and your career. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Have dinner without the television and talk with the people you live with.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.
Until {H:1821099381000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up your money and what you value.
The opposition between the Moon and Venus creates some tension between conversations and your horizons. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Ask the question you are embarrassed to ask: the answer may surprise you.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.
Until {H:1821099381000}, the Moon is still in {S:11} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.
The opposition between the Moon and Venus creates some tension between money and intimacy. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Before buying, wait twenty-four hours and see if you still want it.
